tool_args.rationale: The five pilot rows span only 0.018 in s_grad, so acquire the wide-gradient probe before fitting and use the full fallback parameter range.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the square-root siphon to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad range makes vmax and rho nearly collinear, leaving their separate effects unidentified.
The identified ambiguity is gradient leverage, not temporal resolution; this probe also costs more.
The pilot is monotone concave with no observed high-input decline; the discriminating probe can resolve the supported siphon branch first.
